meta.caveat: Represents filed planned retirements; actual decommissioning timelines are subject to ISO reliability reviews (RMR agreements can extend operation past the filed date).

irp_divergence.note: The utilities' current plans post-date these EIA-860M filings and keep these plants running longer or convert them to gas, which keeps the point of interconnection occupied, so the Arizona rows overstate headroom. DC Hub serves the EIA-860M dates unchanged; check the utility's current IRP before relying on one.
